FollowIn.description: A Plex show or film by its ratingKey, or a library listing with filters to follow as a channel.
FollowIn.title: FollowIn

FromIn.description: Where a play or a channel visit was started from (viewing.py): all optional, so an old page or a typed address still works.
FromIn.title: FromIn

get.description: A page of visits to channel pages, newest first, with where each came from.
Everything known of a channel (library, watch history, suggestion), whether or not the library has it.

post.description: Someone opened the channel's page: kept with where from, for what to suggest later (viewing.py).

get.description: A page of plays, newest first, with every detail kept of each (viewing.recent); `after` is the last one's cursor (`at|id`).

post.description: How a play is going: the page reports it while it plays, on pause and end, and as it is left (POST, so a closing page can send it).

get.description: Every kind of segment the player can skip, with its setting (`skip_<id>`, saved through PUT /api/settings).

post.description: The watching side found these videos missing (a thumbnail or a fetch failed): ask YouTube, and hide the ones it no longer has.

get.description: Continue watching: videos part watched lately, most recent first, each with `resume` and `progress` (viewing.unfinished).
The parts of the video the player can skip, and what it does in each kind (segments.py).
